item.text: Hairy hawkbit (*Leontodon saxatilis*) is a dandelion-like herb native to Europe and North Africa and introduced widely elsewhere, sometimes as a noxious weed. It forms basal rosettes with erect, leafless stems topped by solitary yellow flower heads. Its fruits are cylindrical achenes with scale-like pappi. [Source: s1:p1]
